mapper.insert: INSERT INTO checkout_sagas ( id, customer_id, idempotency_key, status, context_payload, version ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{customerId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{status}, CAST(#{contextPayload} AS JSONB), #{version} )

INSERT INTO checkout_sagas ( id, customer_id, idempotency_key, request_hash, status, context_payload, version ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{customerId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, #{status}, CAST(#{contextPayload} AS JSONB), 0 ) ON CONFLICT ( customer_id, idempotency_key ) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, customer_id, idempotency_key, request_hash, status, context_payload::TEXT AS context_payload, result_payload::TEXT AS result_payload, failure_code, failure_message, version, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM checkout_sagas WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT id, customer_id, idempotency_key, request_hash, status, context_payload::TEXT AS context_payload, result_payload::TEXT AS result_payload, failure_code, failure_message, version, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM checkout_sagas WHERE id = #{checkoutId} AND customer_id = #{customerId}

SELECT id, customer_id, idempotency_key, request_hash, status, context_payload::text AS context_payload, result_payload::text AS result_payload, failure_code, failure_message, version, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM checkout_sagas WHERE id = #{checkoutId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE checkout_sagas SET status = 'ORDER_COMMITTED', version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{checkoutId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE checkout_sagas SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{checkoutId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE checkout_sagas SET status = 'COMPENSATING', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{checkoutId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE checkout_sagas SET status = 'FAILED', version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{checkoutId} AND status = 'COMPENSATING'
UPDATE checkout_sagas SET status = 'COMPLETED', version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{checkoutId} AND status = 'ORDER_COMMITTED'
